{{Quote|Ending ''Alderaanian tourist board Holoplay #2735'', Senator. May I assist you with anything else?|A computer to Leia Organa|<ref name="SW2:SoY" />}}
The '''Alderaanian tourist board Holoplay #2735''' was a [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] commercial released by the [[Alderaanian tourist board]]<ref name="SW2:SoY" /> at some point following the [[Declaration of a New Order|establishment]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="19BBY" /> The holoplay praised the natural beauties of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in order to make it an appealing tourism destination. After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet by the Empire<ref name="SW2:SoY" /> in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="0BBY" /> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Alderaan kept a copy of the advertisement, and she watched it many times while she mourned the loss of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. The holoplay advertised Alderaan's lowland plains and their small [[City/Legends|villages]], the [[Lakes Region]] and its native wildlife, the [[Cobaltia Sea/Legends|Cobaltia Sea]] and its warm [[Water/Legends|waters]], the [[High Council of Alderaan|Alderaan Senate]], the old-fashioned northern cities with ruins predating the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] and the refined yet friendly culture of the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanians]].<ref name="SW2:SoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alderaanian tourist board Holoplay #2735 appeared in [[Star Wars (2013) 2|second issue]] of the [[2013]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series [[Star Wars (2013)|''Star Wars'']]. The issue was written by [[Brian Wood]], illustrated by [[Carlos D'Anda]],<ref name="SW2:SoY" /> and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[February 13]], [[2013]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53942/star_wars_2013_2|text=Star Wars (2013) #2}}</ref>
